name: The escape velocity on the surface of the Earth depends on:
description:
Question:
The escape velocity on the surface of the Earth depends on:


(a) Mass and radius of the Earth
(b) Mass of the escaping body
(c) Direction of projection
(d) Angle of projection

Answer: (a) Mass and Radius of the Earth ✅

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Escape Velocity Formula

Ve = √(2GM/R)

Where,

Ve = Escape Velocity
G  = Universal Gravitational Constant
M  = Mass of Earth
R  = Radius of Earth

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Important Point

Escape Velocity depends on:

✓ Mass of Earth (M)
✓ Radius of Earth (R)

Escape Velocity does NOT depend on:

✗ Mass of body
✗ Direction of projection
✗ Angle of projection

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

For Earth

Ve = 11.2 km/s

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

RELATION BETWEEN G and g

Universal Gravitational Constant

G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m²/kg²

Acceleration due to Gravity

g = GM/R²

Where,

G = Universal Constant
M = Mass of Earth
R = Radius of Earth

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT RELATIONS

g = GM/R²

Ve = √(2GM/R)

Using g = GM/R²

Ve = √(2gR)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

TRICK

"Escape Velocity yaad karo:

V = Root(2gR)

Mass of body nahi,
Earth ke M aur R par hi sahi."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
